objective: Assess whether a separately scoped CNN Fear and Greed challenger experiment is justified by permitted timestamped evidence and a valid unseen-period evaluation design.

checks.description: Independent review of scoped artifacts, relevant focused behavior checks and Human acceptance; execution evidence recorded at implementation time.

acceptance.description: Document source/availability/rights and historical-vintage evidence or the exact absent facts without claiming an admitted dataset.
Compare baseline, challenger and deferral; freeze a leakage-safe matched evaluation plan and stop/continue rule before outcome inspection, with no training or collection.
Deliver a reviewed go/no-go/defer decision with limitations, separate any future implementation authority and keep this optional P3 study outside the final-work critical path.
